title: Book Recommendation: Life in Perspective
author: Scott Young
description: We rarely notice what's closest to us. Perspective is hard to gain, but it is worth cultivating. Here's how. The post Book Recommendation: Life in Perspective appeared first on Scott H Young .
summary: An old fish swims by two young fish and says, “Morning boys, how’s the water?” After he passes by, one young fish looks at the other and says, “What the heck is water?” The joke points to an important truth: we rarely notice what’s closest to us. The traits we have that are most obvious to others are often invisible to us.
takeaways: Still, I found a number of Forte’s points really struck home as he brought attention to many of the ways my own reflective practices often flounder: I’m too problem oriented.
When I designed the keystone habit for Reflection in Foundations, I focused on a daily journaling habit—modeled much after the semi-regular writing habit I use to help myself think better.
We stay stuck too long in jobs, relationships—even identities—that no longer serve us.
